title: Evaluation of a decision tree conversion
statement: For a natural number $n$, a finite-coordinate decision tree $T$ with leaves in the sign set, indexed by an available set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, and an input $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the converted decision-tree hypothesis has the same value at $x$ as $T$.
hypotheses_covered: available set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
decision tree indexed by that set with sign-valued leaves
